|game_text=Use 2 Force to deploy on Han or Back Door; draw top card of Used Pile. Non-Jedi, non-[[Permanent Weapon]] Rebels are defense value +2 and immune to attrition < 3. May place this Effect out of play to cancel the targeting of a weapon at same or related site.

|notes=The recovered original Players Committee sheet is linked from the [[I Wonder Who They Found (V) (Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon) (Original 2005)|2005 publication]]. The recovered original places this Effect in Used Pile to cancel a weapon target. The 9 November 2005 issuer change places it in Lost Pile and limits the cancel to a character weapon. The remaster charges 2 Force, draws a Used Pile card, limits Rebel eligibility, lowers the immunity threshold, removes the Imperial deploy modifier and uses an out-of-play cost at a same or related site. 
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards9.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards9.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, starwarsccg.org CDN; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153015id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards9.pdf#page=2 byte-identical publisher archive]) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #10 on 17 September 2007); page 2, slip 11.
